description: This file contains an implementation of the AES (Rijndael) cipher, supporting only 128-bit keys, with options for size optimization (AES_SMALL_TABLES). It includes key setup, encryption, and decryption functions, and defines lookup tables for AES transformations.

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupEnc
methods.description: Expands the cipher key into the encryption key schedule.

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupDec
methods.description: Expands the cipher key into the decryption key schedule.

methods.name: rijndaelEncrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on a 16-byte plaintext block using the expanded key schedule.

methods.name: rijndaelDecrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on a 16-byte ciphertext block using the expanded key schedule.
